blockers.detail: the decoder harness never calls ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat(); dctx->format stays ZSTD_f_zstd1, so the magicless frame format added by M (ZSTD_startingInputLength magicless arm, ZSTD_getFrameHeader_internal magicless branch) is unreachable

evidence: M (PR #863 newFormats) adds ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless and ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat; tests/fuzz harnesses are unchanged

no in-tree fuzzer selected the magicless format until 741b87bbe (2024-03-20, 'Fuzzing and bugfixes for magicless-format decoding'), which added decompress_cross_format.c and fixed magicless decoding bugs in lib/decompress/zstd_decompress.c
OSS-Fuzz zstd project added 2017-09-29 (eebdc80cb, one day after M); its build.sh builds tests/fuzz via fuzz.py — pinned as oss_rev
rationale_zh: 本次合并（PR #863 newFormats）为解码器新增了无魔数帧格式 ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless，只能通过 ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat() 选择；输入接受的帧格式因此扩展了一种。in-tree 解码 harness stream_decompress.c 未作任何修改，从不设置格式，dctx->format 恒为 ZSTD_f_zstd1：ZSTD_startingInputLength 的无魔数分支、ZSTD_getFrameHeader_internal 中 format==magicless 的分支覆盖恒为 0，harness 却照常运行。这一新输入格式的解码路径直到 2024-03 的 741b87bbe 才被新 fuzzer 覆盖，并随即修复了无魔数解码中的真实 bug。属于本次引入的隐式 input_format 退化；反事实修复 Δh 用种子的一位选择帧格式。
rationale_en: This merge (PR #863 newFormats) adds the magicless frame format ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless to the decoder, selectable only through ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat(), i.e. the decoder now accepts one more frame format. The in-tree decoding harness stream_decompress.c is unchanged and never sets the format, so dctx->format is always ZSTD_f_zstd1: the magicless arm of ZSTD_startingInputLength and the format==magicless branch of ZSTD_getFrameHeader_internal keep zero coverage while the harness runs normally. The magicless decoding path was first fuzzed by a new fuzzer in 741b87bbe (2024-03), which immediately fixed real magicless-decoding bugs. Introduced silent input_format degradation; the counterfactual fix Δh selects the frame format from one seed bit.
